text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm in the process of moving several
folding chairs
for an upcoming meeting
when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The weight of them overwhelms me, and
I lose my
balance! I start falling over,
and the chairs slip
from my grip!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I squeeze my eyes shut, bracing for
impact! But...

Steady there. Were you in search of the
fruit of
eternity, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately for you, it is far from your
time to
alight upon the shores of Tír na
nÓg.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once I'm back on my feet, I take a
moment to
understand the situation.
Tanino Gimlet must
have run over and
caught me just in time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And to top it off, all the chairs are
stacked neatly
on the floor.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? You appear quite
stunned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her how surprised I am that she was
able to
support my weight and catch the
chairs in one go.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I suppose your shock is
understandable.
But know this—that was
nothing out of the
ordinary for one such
as I.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
As I'm sure you know, the great artists
responsible
for the Renaissance were not
only well-versed in
humanism but also in
science.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I am the same. I appreciate tradition, but
I also
crave change.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The intelligence of science, the most
detailed of
methods. In fewer words,
refined speed.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The resilience of humanism, the
paradigm of
everything and anything. In
fewer words,
unwavering strength.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It is the possession of both qualities that

magnifies one's presence, making them
capable
of intoxicating others with their
very being!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I musn't hesitate—a twofold
pursuit is my
calling! Both crowns shall
find themselves within
my grasp!
Hehehe. Hahaha! AAAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I lost the plot on her explanation long
ago, but I
at least understood the
"speed" and "strength"
parts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From what I can tell, she's trying to
obtain both...
I think.
DANG! That was way cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I saw what happened from over there!
You were
so fast!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Not a single chair broke either! How'd
you pull
that off?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Excellently observed. But I would
expect no
less from one with such
commitment to their own
unique
aesthetic.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. Come with me. I'll show you
the path
to Elysium.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From what I can gather, Tanino Gimlet is
intently
focused on speed and strength.
Perhaps that will
allow her to achieve
something no other racer has
before...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, I think it's time to take my
leave.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For if I am to acquire the fruit of
eternity, I must
chart the appropriate
map.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Should fate allow it, we shall meet again.
I will
await you on the shore across the
sea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm in the middle of trying to puzzle out
what
Tanino Gimlet just said when I
notice someone
watching her from afar.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Those who desire too much will
orchestrate their
own ruin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She leaves without saying another word.
Is she
worried about Tanino Gimlet?
